title: Delete asks first
note: Delete opens a small sheet: "Delete this letter?", "It waits in Recently deleted for 30 days." The safe choice, "Keep it", is the large primary button and the default; "Delete letter" is the quiet red one with the Trash icon. No Close in its header: "Keep it" and a swipe down are the ways out. (D-085.)
